name: How Long Does a Hardwood Floor Finish Actually Last
title-tag: How Long Does a Hardwood Floor Finish Last?
meta-description: Roughly 7–10 years in a busy hallway, 15–20+ in bedrooms. A refinishing contractor on what wears a finish out and when to recoat instead of sand.
post-summary: March 17, 2027 · Finish is a consumable, and the useful question isn’t when it fails but when it thins. Realistic lifespans room by room, the five things that burn a finish out early, and the recoat cadence that keeps a floor out of the sander for decades.
